_comment: The canonical barracks_walkthrough fixture: post_tutorial_street's exact state (warrior L1, met/sparred/given_spear, standing at the street gate-arrival cell (1,3)) plus gold:25 -- the ONLY delta from post_tutorial_street.json. barracks_walkthrough needs pre-banked gold to prove the peddler's mini-buy (watch_issue_gambeson, 20g) live without an in-script earn-grind (that mechanic is already proven by economy_loop/inventory_loop); 25 leaves 5 gold spare after the 20g spend so the post-buy state is never accidentally exactly zero (which could mask a wrong subtraction). rng_state "9" carried over -- no combat in this script. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=9, captured .state), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. This fixture's own canonical never resolves a fight to completion off this rng_state, so its exact value is cosmetic/inert for outcome purposes.
